scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleLimsRelease
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleLimsDebug
scripts.build:patient: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 VITE_APP_TARGET=patient vite build --outDir dist-patient
scripts.build:phlebo: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 VITE_APP_TARGET=phlebo vite build --outDir dist-phlebo
scripts.deploy:patient: npm run build:patient && netlify deploy --prod --no-build --dir dist-patient --site anpro-patient
scripts.deploy:phlebo: npm run build:phlebo && netlify deploy --prod --no-build --dir dist-phlebo --site anpro-phlebo
scripts.android:sync:patient: npm run build:patient && cross-env APP_TARGET=patient npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:phlebo: npm run build:phlebo && cross-env APP_TARGET=phlebo npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build:patient: npm run android:sync:patient && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePatientRelease
scripts.android:build:patient:debug: npm run android:sync:patient && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePatientDebug
scripts.android:build:phlebo: npm run android:sync:phlebo && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePhleboRelease
scripts.android:build:phlebo:debug: npm run android:sync:phlebo && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePhleboDebug
scripts.android:bundle:lims: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleLimsRelease
scripts.android:bundle:patient: npm run android:sync:patient && cd android && ./gradlew bundlePatientRelease
scripts.android:bundle:phlebo: npm run android:sync:phlebo && cd android && ./gradlew bundlePhleboRelease
